root_cause: Required Python module 'rndrone' install nahi hai ya requirements.txt me missing hai
explanation: Test execution ke dauran test_app.py file ko import karne ki koshish ki gayi, lekin 'rndrone' naam ka module Python environment me nahi mila. Ye ya to typo hai module name me, ya phir dependencies properly install nahi hui hain. Commit message 'intentionally error' se lagta hai ki ye deliberate mistake hai.
suggested_fix: 1. Pehle check karo ki 'rndrone' sahi module name hai ya 'random' likhna tha (typo check karo). 2. Agar sahi naam hai to requirements.txt me 'rndrone' add karo. 3. CI/CD pipeline me ensure karo ki 'pip install -r requirements.txt' command properly execute ho rahi hai. 4. test_app.py me import statement check karo aur sahi module name use karo.
